key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: 鍵が結晶に反応した!

key: FERN: Hmph.
en: FERN: Hmph.
ja: ファーン: フン。

key: Deflecting a surprise attack with a spontaneously transforming crystal...
en: Deflecting a surprise attack with a spontaneously transforming crystal...
ja: 突然変形する結晶で不意打ちを弾くなんて…

key: Cheap and lucky as always.
en: Cheap and lucky as always.
ja: 相変わらず、こそくで運任せ。

key: I figured you'd eventually show your face around here.
en: I figured you'd eventually show your face around here.
ja: そのうちここに顔を出すだろうとは思ってた。

key: Like the slimy worm you are, you always seem to come out of the woodwork somehow.
en: Like the slimy worm you are, you always seem to come out of the woodwork somehow.
ja: ぬめぬめした虫みたいに、あんたはいつもどこからかはい出してくる。

key: And how?
en: And how?
ja: しかも、どうやって?

key: You know, that attack you did up there with the falling spire was a new low of cowardice.
en: You know, that attack you did up there with the falling spire was a new low of cowardice.
ja: あの上で塔を落としてきた攻撃、ひきょうさの新記録だったよね。

key: You just weasel around everything without a care...
en: You just weasel around everything without a care...
ja: あんたは何も気にせず、するりと全部かわしていく…

key: Because no one's bothered to put you in your place.
en: Because no one's bothered to put you in your place.
ja: 誰もあんたを分相応の位置にたたき落とそうとしないから。

key: You think you have some kind of immunity?
en: You think you have some kind of immunity?
ja: 自分には何か免罪符でもあると思ってる?

key: You think you're better than us?
en: You think you're better than us?
ja: 自分がわたしたちより上だと思ってるの?

key: I doubt you even see the rest of us as human.
en: I doubt you even see the rest of us as human.
ja: あんたはたぶん、わたしたちを人間だとすら思ってない。

key: Won't even deny it.
en: Won't even deny it.
ja: 否定すらしないのね。

key: And STILL you don't say anything.
en: And STILL you don't say anything.
ja: それでもまだ、何も言わない。

key: \PN, let me tell you something.
en: \PN, let me tell you something.
ja: \PN、教えてあげる。

key: When we first met, I thought you were all right.
en: When we first met, I thought you were all right.
ja: 初めて会った時は、まあまあだと思ってた。

key: A little ignorant, a little presumptuous, and way out of your league...
en: A little ignorant, a little presumptuous, and way out of your league...
ja: ちょっと無知で、ちょっと生意気で、自分の実力を全然わかってなくて…

key: But who isn't, these days?
en: But who isn't, these days?
ja: でも、今どきそうじゃない奴なんている?

key: I thought you might be good underneath it all.
en: I thought you might be good underneath it all.
ja: その奥には、いいところがあるんじゃないかって思ってた。

key: It sickens me just how wrong I was.
en: It sickens me just how wrong I was.
ja: 自分がどれだけ間違ってたか、吐き気がするくらいわかった。

key: Decidueye.
en: Decidueye.
ja: ジュナイパー。

key: FERN: If \PN's so determined to run around pointlessly, let's give them something to run from.
en: FERN: If \PN's so determined to run around pointlessly, let's give them something to run from.
ja: ファーン: \PNが意味もなく走り回るつもりなら、走り回る理由をあげる。

key: (It is suggested to turn Speed-Up Mode off for this challenge.)
en: (It is suggested to turn Speed-Up Mode off for this challenge.)
ja: (この挑戦ではスピードアップモードをオフにすることを推奨します。)

key: FERN: Just what do you think you're still doing?
en: FERN: Just what do you think you're still doing?
ja: ファーン: まだ何やってるつもり?

key: You think you can escape me with those kinds of bullshit moves?
en: You think you can escape me with those kinds of bullshit moves?
ja: そんなくだらない動きでわたしから逃げられると思ってる?

key: I'll see you put into the dirt.
en: I'll see you put into the dirt.
ja: 地べたにたたき伏せてやる。

key: FERN: Stop it!
en: FERN: Stop it!
ja: ファーン: やめてよ!

key: What the hell are you made of?!
en: What the hell are you made of?!
ja: 一体何でできてんのよ?!

key: Why is it that you come out on top no matter what?
en: Why is it that you come out on top no matter what?
ja: なんで何をやっても、あんたが結局勝つわけ?

key: It's not just unnatural, it's creepy.
en: It's not just unnatural, it's creepy.
ja: 不自然どころか、気味が悪い。

key: FERN: Decidueye!
en: FERN: Decidueye!
ja: ファーン: ジュナイパー!

key: Enough...
en: Enough...
ja: もういい…

key: FERN: Y-you're--
en: FERN: Y-you're--
ja: ファーン: あ、あんたって――

key: To say you're inhuman would be too much of a compliment.
en: To say you're inhuman would be too much of a compliment.
ja: 人間じゃないって言うのは、あんたにはもったいない褒め言葉。

key: You're like that woman,
en: You're like that woman,
ja: あんたはあの女みたい、

key: Hollow and eerie.
en: Hollow and eerie.
ja: 空っぽで、不気味。

key: Empty of anything but destruction...
en: Empty of anything but destruction...
ja: 破壊以外、何一つ持ってない…

key: No joke, you're even worse than she is.
en: No joke, you're even worse than she is.
ja: 冗談抜きで、あんたはあの女よりひどい。

key: The only difference is that you pretend that everything you're doing is for some kind of bullshit moral cause.
en: The only difference is that you pretend that everything you're doing is for some kind of bullshit moral cause.
ja: 唯一の違いは、あんたが自分のやってることを、くだらない道徳的な大義のためだって装ってること。

key: At least she doesn't hide her selfish intentions.
en: At least she doesn't hide her selfish intentions.
ja: 少なくともあの女は、自分勝手な意図を隠したりしない。

key: You're honestly disgusting...
en: You're honestly disgusting...
ja: 本当に、気持ち悪い…

key: I can't stay around you any more.
en: I can't stay around you any more.
ja: もうあんたのそばにいられない。

key: If I never saw you again, it would be too soon.
en: If I never saw you again, it would be too soon.
ja: 二度と会わなくたって、早すぎるくらい。

key: Reborn was an easier puzzle than I had anticipated.
en: Reborn was an easier puzzle than I had anticipated.
ja: リボーンは想定より簡単なパズルだった。

key: Perhaps this 'X-League' can provide me a worthy challenge.
en: Perhaps this 'X-League' can provide me a worthy challenge.
ja: この『Xリーグ』とやらなら、俺にふさわしい挑戦を与えてくれるかもしれない。

key: You can't always get what you want.
en: You can't always get what you want.
ja: 欲しいものが、いつも手に入るとは限らない。

key: But if you try, sometimes you might just find that you get what you need~
en: But if you try, sometimes you might just find that you get what you need~
ja: でも頑張れば、時々必要なものが手に入ったりするんだよね~

key: An old area map is posted here.
en: An old area map is posted here.
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている。

key: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
en: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
ja: 長い間、誰も手をつけていないようだ。

key: Emerald Branch puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Emerald Branch puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブファイルでエメラルド支線パズルのクリアが確認された。

key: Skip Emerald puzzle on this file?
en: Skip Emerald puzzle on this file?
ja: このファイルでエメラルドパズルをスキップする?

key: FERN: I'm done.
en: FERN: I'm done.
ja: ファーン: もう終わり。

key: This isn't fair.
en: This isn't fair.
ja: こんなの不公平。

key: You just waltz in and activate some magic crystal knowing that's what will let you win.
en: You just waltz in and activate some magic crystal knowing that's what will let you win.
ja: あんたはただ入ってきて、勝てるってわかってる魔法の結晶を起動するだけ。

key: Who cares how much effort anyone else puts in?
en: Who cares how much effort anyone else puts in?
ja: 他の誰がどれだけ努力したかなんて、誰が気にするの?

key: Who cares about the rest of us?
en: Who cares about the rest of us?
ja: わたしたちのことなんて、誰が気にするの?

key: All that matters is that you come out on top.
en: All that matters is that you come out on top.
ja: 大事なのは、あんたが上に立つことだけ。

key: No matter how cheap the method.
en: No matter how cheap the method.
ja: どんなにこそくな手を使ってでも。

key: Y-you're--
en: Y-you're--
ja: あ、あんたって――

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
